description:
Check why emails from a domain might land in spam.

Looks up the domain's public DNS: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), DMARC, MX, and whether its
mail servers are on major blocklists. Returns a 0-100 score and plain-English issues, worst first.
Read-only: it changes nothing and sends no email. DKIM keys on custom selectors can't be found
from outside, so "DKIM not found" is only a hint. Free email providers (gmail.com etc.) aren't checked.

Args:
    domain: The domain that sends the email, e.g. "joesplumbing.com". A website URL or an
        email address also works; the domain is taken from it.
name: check_email_deliverability
title: Check email deliverability
